Relative to a fixed origin O, the point A has the position vector $\left( 2 \hat { \iota } - \hat { \jmath } + 5 \hat { k } \right)$ , and the point 11 B has the position vector $\left( 5 \hat { \imath } + 2 \hat { \jmath } + 1 0 \hat { k } \right)$ , and D has the position vector $\left( - \hat { \imath } + \hat { \jmath } + 4 \hat { k } \right)$ Find the vector equation of a line l that passes through the points A and B, and hence find the shortest distance from the point D to the line l.
